citations.title: Mastercard reorganizes leadership to deepen its bench

sentences.text: On June 2, 2026, Mastercard announced a broad set of leadership changes effective August 3, 2026, with Chief Financial Officer Sachin Mehra moving to a newly created Chief Business Officer role covering country operations worldwide under a single global go-to-market structure, and Ling Hai, President for Asia Pacific, Europe, Middle East and Africa, succeeding him as CFO.

Linda Kirkpatrick became Chief Services Officer, succeeding Craig Vosburg, who became Vice Chair; Dimi Dosis became Chief Commercial Payments Officer, succeeding Raj Seshadri, now Senior Strategic Advisor to the CEO.
